title: UK, Singapore, and Thailand central banks complete foreign exchange settlement trial linking traditional and tokenized systems
message_html: UK, Singapore, and Thailand central banks complete foreign exchange settlement trial linking traditional and tokenized systems ...
snippet: Three central banks published findings from a cross-border FX settlement trial using Partior's synchronization prototype.

title: Deloitte acquires Flipside Crypto's AI business and launches Edisyl
message_html: Deloitte acquires Flipside Crypto's AI business and launches Edisyl ...
snippet: Deloitte today introduced Edisyl Inc., an enterprise AI company formed in connection with Deloitte's acquisition of the AI business of Flipside Crypto Inc., which was completed in July.

title: Wirex launches Navoka, an AI agent that pays from its own bank account and card
message_html: Wirex launches Navoka, an AI agent that pays from its own bank account and card ...
snippet: Wirex, the global stablecoin infrastructure platform, has today launched Navoka, the first AI agent that pays on behalf of users from a dedicated bank account and card.
